focus: single-checkout mechanisms, churn detector role, relocation matrix, ranked verdict

label: Per-lane write redirection on one checkout needs mount namespaces/FUSE/overlay — absent on APFS, and on Linux it is the overlay option already ruled out for live-lower read-through; GIT_INDEX_FILE-per-lane cannot hide foreign writes to shared bytes

OS-level write denial (seatbelt/Landlock) makes out-of-scope writes impossible at ~0 cost — vacuously exact attribution, but it answers prevention not attribution: allowlist gaps become lane failures and denied writes leave nothing to quarantine
Per-process write attribution (EndpointSecurity/fanotify/eBPF) is exact on shared bytes but privileged or entitlement-gated — unreachable for a runner spawning unprivileged CLIs
source: platform capability survey; runner spawn model in fanout-run.cjs

label: Tree-diff attribution on shared bytes is structurally unsound — the module says the tree cannot name a writer; every unattributableDirs/Paths carve-out and foreign-run discovery is an admission
Shipped churn detector is burst-only (per-window newlyDirty > threshold, default 3) while REQ-004 specifies 12/window OR 40 cumulative — a slow foreign drip never latches preserve
Inside a private lane tree foreign writers cannot exist, so churn bursts are unambiguous lane misbehavior; under write denial observed churn is foreign by construction

git worktree move survives every registered variant (sparse cone, clonefile, full checkout); absolute dep links target the unmoved main checkout; relative self-links were built for this; only moving the enclosing checkout breaks registrations — a shared constraint

Ranked: (a) --no-checkout + clonefile incl. dep roots (~1-4 s, ~0 disk, exact attribution, escape closed); (b) sparse-cone worktree as portable fallback (~3% cone); (c) seatbelt denial as optional complement on degraded/shared path
Concurrency caps (8 lanes, 256 expanded lineages) make the cost decisive: 8 lanes peak ~12.8 GB; 256 lineages serialize ~94 min of provisioning — both collapse under clonefile
